title: DASH AI · Trading rules
description: Describe a trading habit; DASH builds it into a rule, backtests it, saves it. Your active rules, on / off, delete.

screens.name: DASH landing
screens.note: From the DASH pill in the Stocks home top bar (stocks-01; first visit: the coach mark, stocks-08). Back returns home. Set Trading Rules opens the rules chat; Create Custom Strategy is another flow (not designed yet). ☰ opens your rules.

screens.name: Rules · what to set
screens.note: Figma “DASH AI - better layout” 2 (6494:30374): the chat’s empty state — the same screen as the landing and the conversation; the body pushes in from the landing while the background and the bar stay. Example rows drift sideways. A chip (or typing + Send) sends the message: it flies up into the chat as the greeting and examples fade away. History opens your rules.

screens.name: Rules · typing
screens.note: Figma “DASH AI - better layout” 3.1 (file 9r61YQp7QQZAQovDyz8hLF): the input tapped — heading and examples fold away, the orb stays centred, the input turns green, the keyboard rises and the background ends above it (300 ms). Tap the body to go back.

screens.name: Thinking
screens.note: Moves on by itself after 1.6 s in the prototype (the real app: when DASH replies).

screens.name: DASH asks the limit
screens.note: The question card takes the input’s place. Any answer (or one typed) builds the preview.

screens.name: Rule preview
screens.note: The draft is pinned in the top bar’s bottom slot. Proceed runs the backtest; refine goes back to the question.

screens.name: Ready · would have saved
screens.note: Backtest: would have saved ₹18,400 in 3 months (green strip). The description opens Read more.

screens.name: Weak · would have cost profit
screens.note: Backtest: the rule would have cut ₹22,390 of profit — red glow and strip; DASH suggests improving it.

screens.name: Ready · no backtest data
screens.note: Not enough trading history to test: a neutral strip.

screens.name: Read more · cost
screens.note: Figma says ₹22,300 here and ₹22,390 on the card — one number (₹22,390) used for both.

screens.name: Rule created
screens.note: Over the ready screen it was saved from (Figma shows an older card behind it).

screens.name: Active rules
screens.note: Switches turn a rule on / off in place. Delete asks first; Create New starts a new rule.

screens.name: Delete rule?
screens.note: Over the current Active rules (Figma shows an older list with Active / Paused tabs behind it).

screens.name: Rule deleted
screens.note: The list behind already has 3 rules.

screens.name: Active rules · after delete
screens.note: Not a Figma frame: the list once the sheet closes (3 rules).

screens.name: Indicator · what to show
screens.note: Third option on the DASH landing. Empty chat: example prompts; a chip or typed text flies up and DASH reads it.

screens.name: Indicator · which chart
screens.note: DASH asks only what the prompt didn’t say: the chart… (Version 2: only for “…on 15-min candles”; then it builds)

screens.name: Indicator · which timeframe
screens.note: …and the timeframe. (Version 2: only for “…on Nifty 50”.)

screens.name: Indicator · building
screens.note: Version 1: the card pins above the chat; Version 2: it builds inside the chat, under DASH’s message (the “any 15-min chart” example comes straight here). It builds live: a wave, then candles with the lines drawing in, the parts as chips, three steps ticking (~3.3 s in the prototype).

screens.name: Indicator · ready
screens.note: Preview has Modify (manual changes in chat) and Save indicator. The illustrative chart remains unchanged after a modification.

screens.name: Indicator · saved
screens.note: Version 1: the preview card is removed. Version 2: the card stays in the chat, tagged Saved. DASH confirms the indicator is saved and View indicator opens Scalper’s active Indicators sheet with the new indicator in Your indicators.

screens.name: Indicator · saved sheet
screens.note: Version 2: Save indicator opens this over the chat — the tick bursts, “Your indicator is ready to use”, a summary of it. Done closes it (the chat is saved); View indicator opens Scalper’s Indicators sheet with it under Your indicators.
